subject: Pendidikan Islam
edition: KSSM Pendidikan Islam Tingkatan 4 dan 5, Bahagian Pembangunan Kurikulum, September 2018 (Terbitan 2018)
structureNote: Printed hierarchy: Bidang (1 Al-Quran, 2 Hadis, 3 Akidah, 4 Fiqah, 5 Sirah dan Tamadun Islam, 6 Akhlak Islamiah) > Standard Kandungan (SK, numbered continuously across Tingkatan 1-5 within each bidang, e.g. T4 Al-Quran = 1.26-1.32, T5 = 1.33-1.38) > Standard Pembelajaran (SP, e.g. 1.26.1, each introduced by 'Murid dapat:') and Standard Prestasi (6 Tahap Penguasaan with a tafsiran per SK; 'tahapPenguasaan' therefore sits inside each standard, not at unit level; a descriptor may hold several bullet statements separated by newline). The DSKP content pages are written in Jawi (Malay in Arabic script) with Arabic Quran/Hadith text; text is preserved as printed (logical RTL order). Part of the Arabic/Jawi text is embedded as small images in the PDF (surah names, Hadith lines, Jawi word fragments); these were transcribed by reading the images, so minor diacritic/spelling deviations from print are possible. Some Jawi words are printed with unusual spelling (e.g. word-final ه for ة, 'اهلل' without shadda, 'إسالم'); kept as printed/extracted. Bidang titles on page headers are images; names taken from the contents page (Latin). Organisation: 96 jam minimum setahun (menengah atas). Symbol-font glyphs that extract as Latin letters are normalised: H/U after 'رسول الله' = ﷺ (SAW) and W after a Companion name = رضي الله عنه (RA).
